name: MBDP
summary: MBDP, also known as N-methyl-1,3-benzodioxolylpentanamine, 3,4-methylenedioxy-α-propyl-N-methylphenethylamine, methyl-K, or UWA-091, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, phenylisobutylamine, and MDxx families. It is the N-methyl analogue of BDP (K).

fact.en: MBDP stretches MDMA's side chain, carrying a propyl group where MDMA has a methyl. It is the N-methyl partner of BDP, a compound known by the letter K.
fact.zh: MBDP 把 MDMA 的側鏈拉長，在 MDMA 接甲基的位置改接丙基。它是 BDP 的 N-甲基版本，而 BDP 又以字母「K」為代號。
fact.zhHans: MBDP 把 MDMA 的侧链拉长，在 MDMA 接甲基的位置改接丙基。它是 BDP 的 N-甲基版本，而 BDP 又以字母「K」为代号。
